note: P is one design four times: the same dark or light rounded card with a mode tab pill, a thick ring around the time, a Start/Reset/Skip row, dots and three minute inputs. Q varies in layout (centered blue, left-aligned mono, full-bleed red) but is all giant-numeral typography, mostly with a linear bar, with two near-identical blue ones. R spans a ring dial, a tiny near-bare mono layout, a huge mono numeral and a tab-pill page, so it differs most in scale and way of showing time, though two entries are still similar.
